---
title: "Typst: a citation to an inline-only reference"
format: typst
references:
  - id: smith2020
    type: webpage
    title: A page
    author:
      - family: Smith
        given: Jane
    issued:
      date-parts: [[2020, 7, 12]]
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      shouldError: default
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: "Q-21-5"
---

bd-yjf99rzx: Typst's native bibliography reads only `bibliography:` files,
so a key defined only in front-matter `references:` would fail `typst
compile` with a bare label error (in Quarto 1 too). Q2 stops first with
Q-21-5.

See [@smith2020].
